def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    rot180 = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    h = [row[::-1] for row in grid]
    v = grid[::-1]
    tiles = [[rot180, v, rot180], [h, grid, h], [rot180, v, rot180]]
    return [sum((tiles[bi][bj][ri] for bj in range(3)), [])
            for bi in range(3) for ri in range(n)]
